meta.title: Implement exponential backoff for Copilot refresh after commenting on Padawan PRs
meta.body_summary: Add exponential backoff with early exit detection to Copilot timeline refresh after commenting, reducing delay from fixed 1s to adaptable 500ms-5s polling, improving responsiveness.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added exponential backoff with early exit; alexr00 CHANGES_REQUESTED due to yarn.lock changes and later refined delays/test design; PR merged after fixes.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Raw line count is large (5518) but most churn is yarn.lock (5296 lines, reverted). The functional change in issueOverview.ts (~64 lines) is small-to-medium. This small-step performance PR merged after scope correction and design adjustments, consistent with the outcome.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer alexr00 CHANGES_REQUESTED because yarn.lock was touched unnecessarily. Copilot reverted it. Later, maintainer revised backoff intervals and deleted unit tests before approving.
review_details.performance_claim: Exponential backoff with early exit reduces average refresh delay from fixed 1s to adaptive 500ms–5s polling, showing new Copilot sessions more responsively.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot implemented a polling backoff optimization in the extension code. Merge required scope isolation (no lockfile changes) and maintainer-driven parameter tuning.

detection_detail.code_reading: alexr00 identified extraneous yarn.lock changes and requested removal; later revised delay intervals and test design manually.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body describes expected latency reduction but provides no before/after timing metrics; no benchmark or profiler evidence is present.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After CHANGES_REQUESTED, Copilot reverted yarn.lock; maintainer then adjusted delays, simplified refresh logic, and deleted tests within the same PR.

core_change_summary.description: In src/github/issueOverview.ts, replaced a fixed 1-second timeout with a loop over [500,1000,2000,5000]ms delays that polls the timeline for new CopilotStarted events and refreshes early. Maintainer later changed delays to [200,500,1000,2000] and removed CopilotStarted filtering to refresh on any new timeline event. Unintended yarn.lock changes were reverted, and a test file was added then deleted.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: yarn.lock was modified and later reverted; copilotRefresh.test.ts was added and then removed by maintainer.
change_trajectory: Initial plan and analysis commits introduced unintended yarn.lock changes.
Implemented exponential backoff logic and added unit tests.
Maintainer adjusted delays to [200,500,1000,2000] and simplified refresh condition to any timeline event.
Maintainer deleted added unit tests as 'useless'.
Final tweak: smaller starting delay; approved and merged.
